parameters.name: AccountStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the member accounts to query. You can set this parameter to query member accounts in a specific status. Valid values:

- **enabled**: The member account is managed.

- **disabled**: The member account is not managed.

- **disabling**: The member account is being removed.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.
